brief.zh: 只用与门和非门，算出「下雨，或者刮风」在每一行的真值。
brief.en: Using only And and Not, work out the value of “it rains or it is windy” on every row.

t.zh: 「或」写作 ∨：至少一边为真，它就为真。证明器里还没有这个门。
t.en: “Or” is written ∨: true when at least one side is. The prover has no gate for it yet.

hint.zh: 先看它什么时候为假：四行里只有一行。
hint.en: Look first at when it is false: only one row of the four.
